source_timing: The 110 regression tests passed before the mechanical nested-if to let-chain cleanup. Final primary (20 tests), private (5 tests), strict and minimal checks passed afterward; the cleanup changes no runtime branch or output. Superseded primary/private passes are not counted again.
contracts: Both ordinary input relations finish materialization and validation before directory construction. Whole-operation actual-key mismatch falls back before output; cancellation, resource, allocation and selected-source errors never silently retry.
Exact active paired descriptors establish the existing five-carrier proof. No first-row inference, mixed numeric coercion, Text policy relaxation, partial AND extraction or new grammar.
NULL has no join fingerprint and never matches NULL. Hashes only select candidates; existing written-direction scalar equality evaluates matching fingerprints.
Append-linked buckets and rebuilds preserve original right encounter and duplicate order. Left-major matched order, LEFT NULL padding and final RIGHT unmatched order remain unchanged.

Actual bucket/entry capacities are prepaid/fallibly reserved; hashes, preflight, probes, collision traversal and growth are metered and cancellable. Directory allocation and work intentionally change quota thresholds.
independent_controls: Independent encounter-order model across all five proven carriers, nullable and boundary keys including LongLong neighbours above 2^53, both operand directions, both arithmetic profiles and INNER/LEFT/RIGHT joins.
Generated 1,100 default-work and 12,000 bounded joins; active declared-only Int16 proof through derived reads, pruned/nested slot mapping and retained payload/declaration/policy behavior.
Raw String observers, selected bad-source/EOF failures, empty opposite input, unchanged general-predicate error paths, every observed cancellation checkpoint, cumulative limits and reuse.
Private forced bucket/full-fingerprint collisions, append/rebuild ordering, exact charged storage, growth cancellation and late unexpected carrier/Error/missing-key fallback.
